title: HELLO WORLD COMPUTER
author: Han × 1001
facts: contract storage; int32 packed in uint256[128]
learns inside Ethereum: weights start at zero and update when each question settles
a yes/no label with a confidence value
description: This contract holds a perceptron, the simplest type of neural network. The contract stores the weights, trains them, and answers questions. You send it a short text of up to 64 bytes. It returns a yes/no label and a confidence value. All weights started at zero. Anyone can pay a fee to post a yes/no question. Each settled question updates the weights inside the contract.

call.note: ask(text) runs the model on your text and returns a label and a confidence value.

input.label: TEXT
input.hint: Use only lowercase letters a–z and spaces. You can enter up to 8 words and 64 bytes. With these letters, 64 bytes is 64 characters.
input.patternMessage: Use only lowercase letters a–z and spaces. Include at least one letter.
